svg.title: heads shapes
svg.text: 2048 → 32 × 64: split into heads, then put heads first
q.view(N, 32, 64) only re-reads each row in pieces; .transpose(0, 1) makes the head the first axis
q.view(N, 32, 64): [N, 32, 64] same memory, read as 32 pieces of 64
k and v do the same with 8 heads: [N, 512] → view → [N, 8, 64] → transpose → [8, N, 64] (a deck of 8).
animated: pieces separate (view), then fly into the deck (transpose), head 31 at the back, head 0 in front
